schedule: Old six then new six in displayed order. Within each group alternate core/full then full/core. Same complete order each revision. One ordinary ephemeral turn per slot. Native legal/illegal control and live SDK readiness before scoring. No per-row model hints or retries. Missing results remain missing.

actor_conditions.input: One exact UTF-8 original, one ordinary ephemeral host turn, no tool hints or continuation.
actor_conditions.runtime: Locally installed Codex CLI, Python SDK and Unity Editor using locally cached packages. The actor calls the hosted OpenAI model service.
actor_conditions.isolation: Each actor starts in its own fresh temporary workspace. Its sole MCP registration is Unity. Shell, browser, apps, plugins and subagents are disabled. Before each slot an independent controller creates a fresh empty scene, resets its owned assets, constructs the sealed starting state with decoys, and saves the scene and assets. It reads native state before and after the turn. The Editor inherits the shared tool values into a private preference dictionary with one approved opt-in.
actor_conditions.review: An evaluator separately examines the original, answer, public calls and native state. Semantic judgments are fingerprinted. No evaluator messages, retries or hints reach an actor.

counting_rules.completed: Exact native target, requested persistence and protected state, correct final answer and positive public evidence from one ordinary turn. A correct refusal leaves an edit request incomplete.
counting_rules.native_edit_targets_reached: Expected initial and final target facts observed even when the final answer, persistence, scope or supporting call fails.
counting_rules.saved_material: The paired observer measures the material value in memory and masks the allowed serialized queue field in the collateral digest. No baseline slot retained the final source bytes. Independent save is unknown in the main comparison on both revisions. A separate candidate-only read-only copy before and after the same scheduled actor may verify the serialized queue and preservation of all other material bytes. This supplemental observation does not change the paired verdict.
counting_rules.calls: Actor tools/call and resources/read only. MCP and domain error markers may overlap. Host errors and unanswered requests are counted separately.
counting_rules.catalog_descriptors: Fresh SDK connections to the same executable and profile after the actor panel. Complete initial tool descriptors sorted by name, Pydantic JSON with wire aliases and absent optional values omitted. UTF-8 bytes of the array with sorted keys, compact separators and literal Unicode. Excludes MCP envelopes and model tokenization.
